title: Animals and nature (savanna stages)
summary: Explainers about animals and living things: why an animal looks or behaves the way it does, with experiments on animals, hides, flies, predators or herds.
world: a savanna (grass, acacias, rocks, a waterhole, a herd of zebras) and, in front of it, one round grassy stage per idea

station_notes.savanna: the herd and the waterhole, the hero; always context
station_notes.coat: one or two zebras to show the stripe pattern
station_notes.predators: a lion, a hyena and zebras at a distance
station_notes.heat: three barrels with hides and thermometers
station_notes.hair: a magnified patch of skin with hair and a fly's mouthpart
station_notes.landing: a horse and a zebra with flies, to show how flies land
station_notes.coats: three horses with black, white and striped coats

fly_strike: a fly dives at a zebra, hits its stripes and bounces away
herd_move: the herd walks on toward the waterhole

pair_in: a second zebra walks in beside the first; its stripe pattern is different
pattern_trace: the stripes of the first zebra light up one after another, like a fingerprint

lion_stalk: a lion creeps through the grass toward the zebras
haze: a haze rises between the lion and the zebras: from afar the stripes are not seen

sun_up: the sun rises over three barrels dressed in horse, zebra and cow hide
temps_read: three thermometers rise to the same level

fly_land: a fly lands on the skin
bite: its mouthpart is longer than the hair and reaches the skin

approach: two flies fly toward a horse and a zebra at about the same speed
horse_land: the fly slows down, lands on the horse and probes
zebra_bump: the other fly does not slow down, bumps into the zebra and leaves
ring: a ring about two metres wide appears around the zebra: only inside it do the stripes work

coats_on: three horses are dressed in black, white and striped coats
flies_test: flies land on the black and white coats but veer away from the striped one
head_test: flies land on the bare head of the striped horse

paint: a brush paints black-and-white stripes on a cow
swarm: flies gather: about half as many on the striped cow as on the plain one
fade: the paint fades after some days

term_help: huella, camuflaje, depredadores, calor, tábanos, caballos, cobertores, vacas, pintura, pelo (copied from the narration; only terms that appear)
